projectDescription: A collection of open-source server tools for running a private Rakion game server, including a launcher update system, authentication backend, database schema, and file/texture utilities.
keyFeatures: AutoQuery: scheduled MySQL stored-procedure runner that cleans pending presents on a configurable timer
FixLaunch: Windows GUI tool that writes the correct Rakion installation path and version into the Windows Registry
TexTools: command-line utilities (TexFix and TexValidation) for patching and inspecting Rakion .tex texture files
PHP web backend: launcher login authentication, per-login gold/cash rewards, and multi-file update fetch API
GConfig: compiled game configuration editor for server settings
Full MySQL database schema including user accounts, characters, clans, items, ranking tables, and launcher fetch tables
Multi-language launcher binaries (English and Spanish load.bin)
MD5/SHA-1 file integrity check endpoint for core game DLLs and data files
publicApiSurface: MySqlBase.Init(host, user, password, database, port) — connects to the Rakion MySQL database
MySqlBase.Execute(sql, args) — executes a non-query SQL statement
MySqlBase.Select(sql, args) — executes a SELECT and returns an SQLResult (DataTable subclass)
MySqlBase.CommandSQL(procedureName) — calls a stored procedure by name
TimerX(minutes, maxCount, infinite, delayMs) — drives the periodic stored-procedure execution
TexFix.exe <original.tex> <new.tex> — splices the header of original.tex onto the body of new.tex
TexValidation.exe <file.tex> — parses and prints all header fields of a .tex file
FixLaunch.exe — GUI: sets HKLM\SOFTWARE\Softnyx\Rakion Location and Version registry keys
launcherlogin.php?user=<id>&pass=<hex-encoded-password> — returns SHA-1 auth token or error string
fetch/fetch.php?<AppId>&<clientVersion> — returns update manifest lines (+NoticeUrl, =FileUrl, ~count;size;verLimit, file records)
file.php?f=<filename>&md5= — returns SHA-1 hash for rakion.bin, entitiesmp.dll, engine.dll, buddy2.dll, datasetup.xfs
fetchfile table — (AppId, Command[M|R], FileIns, FileDir, FileVer, FileSize)
